We exist to fix
a broken pricing model.

GHLS Inc. is a specialty wholesale distributor focused on two categories — Women's Health and Medical Diagnostics — because deep focus is the only way to deliver pricing that actually moves the needle for clinics.

FDA-Compliant Inventory Two Focused Categories Wholesale Pricing

Our Mission

Clinics shouldn't have to choose between quality and margin.

Most medical distributors operate on a simple model: buy product, mark it up, sell it to clinics. The margin they need to cover their overhead comes directly out of your operating budget — and the bigger the distributor, the bigger the markup.

GHLS was built around a different idea. By staying narrowly focused on Women's Health and Medical Diagnostics — the two categories where clinics spend the most and waste the most — we can work the supply chain more intelligently, find pricing others miss, and pass those savings directly to the clinics we serve.

We don't compete with general-line distributors. We out-source them in the categories that matter most to you.

"Smart sourcing isn't cutting corners — it's understanding the supply chain well enough to find value others miss."

— GHLS Procurement Team
15–30% typical savings versus standard distributor pricing
100% FDA-compliant inventory across every SKU we carry
2 focused categories — no filler, no distraction
1day quote turnaround — every request, every time

How We Work

The GHLS sourcing model

Four principles that define every procurement decision we make on behalf of our clinic partners.

Compliance first, always

Every product we carry is FDA-cleared and meets all applicable CLIA and state-level clinical standards. We do not source outside regulated channels — ever. Savings that create compliance risk aren't savings at all.

Active market procurement

We don't passively reorder from a single supplier. Our procurement team actively monitors the market for supply opportunities — excess inventory, favorable contract windows, direct manufacturer relationships — and uses every one of them to reduce your cost.

Full documentation, every order

Lot numbers, expiration dates, and chain of custody are included on every shipment. Your compliance team gets everything they need without having to ask for it. Documentation is part of the service, not an afterthought.

One contact, real relationship

You'll work with a dedicated rep — not a call center, not a ticketing system. Someone who knows your clinic, your volume, your preferences, and your history. That's how we catch issues before they become problems and anticipate what you need before you have to ask.

Why GHLS

We're not a general distributor who added a product line.
We're specialists.

The difference matters more than it sounds. General distributors spread their buying power across thousands of SKUs. We concentrate ours in two categories — which means stronger supplier leverage, faster restocking, and better prices specifically on the products your clinic orders every single week.
